# Terraform (HashiCorp)

HashiCorp's official Terraform skills: HCL style, module refactoring, Terraform tests, search and bulk import, Stacks, Terraform policy (including Sentinel conversion), Azure Verified Modules, and provider development with the Plugin Framework (resources, actions, ephemeral resources, configuration, SDKv2 migration, docs, and acceptance tests).

## Install

| Host | How |
|---|---|
| Claude Code | `/plugin marketplace add talkops-ai/devops-plugins`, then `/plugin install terraform@talkops-devops-plugins` |
| Codex | `codex plugin marketplace add talkops-ai/devops-plugins`, then install from the Plugins Directory |
| Other Agent Plugins hosts | Load this directory; [`plugin.json`](./plugin.json) and `skills/` follow the portable [Agent Plugins](https://agent-plugins.org) format |

## How it works

This is a **partner-built plugin**: HashiCorp's official content, copied unmodified and redistributed under its MPL-2.0 license. Its skills attach directly to your main agent, with no sub-agent hand-off.

- Skills activate from their descriptions; in Claude Code invoke one explicitly with `/terraform:<skill>`
